QuestInfo.name: Another Protector's Reward
QuestInfo.0: Chief Stan is preparing a thank-you present for the warriors who are protecting Henesys from the Monster Kindergarten. Speak with Chief Stan.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Stan was making presents himself for the warriors who protected Henesys. He says that he will be awarding #i1142971:##t1142971# to the warriors who protect Henesys 10 times, and #i3014013:##t3014013# to those who protect Henesys 30 times.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: You were gifted #i3014013:##t3014013# from Chief Stan for protecting Henesys 30 times.
